تقترعين (form VIII)
# تَقْتَرِعِينَ (taqtariʕīna) /taq.ta.ri.ʕiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِقْتَرَعَ (iqtaraʕa)
# تُقْتَرَعِينَ (tuqtaraʕīna) /tuq.ta.ra.ʕiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِقْتَرَعَ (iqtaraʕa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
